caption: The drawing depicts an iron cross that forms the central feature of a decorative fence or gate. The cross is rendered in shades of brown and is adorned with symmetrical swirling and floral motifs on either side of its base, which are also brown. The lower section of the drawing shows vertical iron bars extending downward from a horizontal bar, also adorned with small spikes and finials at the ends. Behind the fence and cross, there is a light blue sketch of a stone structure, possibly a building or part of a tomb, drawn with minimal detail. The background is off-white, and the drawing is composed to emphasize the ironwork against the pale architectural form behind it.
title: Cross
